Meeting notes from the product sync:

**Mobile app launch** (September 1): Alex is the lead. Main blocker is App Store review (5-7 business days), so we need to submit by August 22 at the latest.

**Customer feedback**: Ryan presented Q2 survey results. Top complaint is slow loading on older devices, specifically iPhone 10 and below. We agreed to do a performance pass before launch.

**Headcount**: Sarah got approval for two new backend engineers starting in October. She will post the job descriptions by end of this week.
